text:
The immediate constraints lock three blocks: Ben–Hana, Elif–Finn–Gus, and Ann–Ivo.

Ben is before Finn, so Ben–Hana sits entirely before Elif–Finn–Gus. Cara and Dev are both before Ben, and Ann–Ivo is after Gus. No one else exists to sit in the gaps, so those blocks join into one run of seven: Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo.

That run needs two slots in front of it for Cara and Dev, with Cara before Dev. The only fit is slots 1–2, then the run in 3–9.
